It’s live 🤍✨  

After months of building, dreaming, second guessing, rebuilding, and pouring my whole heart into this… my new business and website are officially LIVE.

The Luxora Collective is out in the world.

This isn’t just a website launch. It feels like a personal milestone. A new chapter. A “she actually did it” moment.

So much of this past year has stretched me in ways I never expected. There were seasons that felt heavy. Uncertain. Quietly rebuilding behind the scenes. And in the middle of all of that, I was building this.

Late nights. Big vision boards. Hard conversations. Refining what I stand for. Getting clearer on the kind of impact I want to make.

This business represents clarity.
It represents courage.
It represents choosing to build something aligned instead of something convenient.

Seeing it live feels emotional in the best way.

If you’ve supported me, prayed for me, checked in on me, collaborated with me, or simply believed in me when things felt hard… thank you. You are part of this.

I’m really proud of this one.

New season. New energy. New level.

The link is in the comments if you want to see what I’ve been working on 🤍
